title: Developers Continue to Optimize iPhone Apps for the Duo
content_html:
Developers Continue to Optimize iPhone Apps for the Duo

Greg Joswiak on X:

Over 200,000 apps are now optimized for iPhone Duo! That number DOUBLED in just over a week.

I’m back on my Duo review unit to test the new face unlock feature, and I’ve already noticed more apps are Duo optimized. Oddly enough, the first one I checked that still isn’t Duo-optimized is Apple’s own Apple Store app, which was last updated 3 months ago. Weird.

Update: The very next day, the Apple Store app was updated with full optimization for the Duo. But then the store’s back end went down for several hours.

★ Monday, 16 November 2026
